subject: Archaeology
title: Ancient Aliens: Why the Theory Is Wrong
description: One-minute skill: Ancient Aliens: Why the Theory Is Wrong.

hook.text: A popular TV show claims aliens built the pyramids, Nazca Lines, and Stonehenge.

buildup.text: Ancient alien claims argue that ancient peoples were too 'primitive' to build their own monuments.

discovery.text: We have the tools, quarries, construction ramps, and worker villages for the pyramids.

twist.text: The theory is rooted in racism. It implies non-European peoples needed alien help — but no one claims aliens built.

climax.text: Ancient peoples were intelligent, creative, and capable. Denying their achievements insults their legacy.

punchline.text: Humans built it all. The real mystery is why some people cannot accept that.

quiz.question: What underlying bias do scholars identify in ancient alien theories?
options: They are funded by governments to distract from real archaeological discoveries
They imply non-European peoples needed alien help — a fundamentally racist assumption
They are based on misinterpretations of sacred religious texts
